name: @dnd/desktop
description: The local-first D&D Auto Notes desktop shell.

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build:core && npm run build:main && npm run build:preload
scripts.package: npm run build && npm run rebuild:electron && electron-builder --projectDir ../.. --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.package:dir: npm run build && npm run rebuild:electron && electron-builder --projectDir ../.. --config electron-builder.yml --dir
